name: Layer & Release Map
blurb: Yocto releases with their LTS and end-of-life dates, and a bblayers stack checked for compatibility
intro: Draws the Yocto release line (release, LTS, end of life, as of Sep 2026) and your bblayers.conf as a stack by BBFILE_PRIORITY with LAYERDEPENDS arrows, and runs the checks BitBake itself makes when it reads the layers: LAYERSERIES_COMPAT against the core's series, missing or wrong-version dependencies, duplicate collections, unset patterns, priority ties.

inputs.label: Target release
inputs.help: The release you build on or plan to move to; auto takes LAYERSERIES_CORENAMES from the core layer.

inputs.label: bblayers.conf
inputs.default:
# POKY_BBLAYERS_CONF_VERSION is increased each time build/conf/bblayers.conf
# changes incompatibly
POKY_BBLAYERS_CONF_VERSION = "2"

BBPATH = "${TOPDIR}"
BBFILES ?= ""

BSPDIR = "${TOPDIR}/.."

BBLAYERS_NXP ?= " \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-toradex-nxp \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-freescale \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-freescale-3rdparty \
"

BBLAYERS ?= " \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/openembedded-core/meta \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-yocto/meta-poky \
  ${BBLAYERS_NXP} \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-arm/meta-arm-toolchain \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-arm/meta-arm \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-toradex-bsp-common \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-openembedded/meta-oe \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-openembedded/meta-python \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-openembedded/meta-networking \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-freescale-distro \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-qt5 \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-clang \
  ${BSPDIR}/layers/meta-mycompany \
"
inputs.help: build/conf/bblayers.conf as it is; variables set in the file are expanded.

usage: Give bblayers (the bblayers.conf text), layerconfs (every layer's conf/layer.conf, each preceded by a line '==> path/conf/layer.conf <=='), optionally target (a codename such as scarthgap, or auto for the core layer's LAYERSERIES_CORENAMES) and off (comma-separated layer folder names to leave out). It returns the target release's LTS/EOL status, the stack by priority with each layer's declared series and dependencies, a release table, and warnings phrased as BitBake's own errors with the fix. Use it before a build to catch layer-compatibility and dependency errors, or to see which layers already declare a release you plan to move to.
sources: bitbake/lib/bb/cookerdata.py (LAYERSERIES_CORENAMES / LAYERSERIES_COMPAT check, duplicated BBFILE_COLLECTIONS) and cooker.py handleCollections() (LAYERDEPENDS, LAYERVERSION, BBFILE_PRIORITY, BBFILE_PATTERN), bitbake 2.8 (scarthgap)

Yocto Project Reference Manual, 'Yocto Project Releases and the Stable Release Process' (LTS every two years for four years; stable releases seven months; Kirkstone to May 2026, Scarthgap to April 2028)
wiki.yoctoproject.org/wiki/Releases for release months; data as of 2026-09, entries marked planned or estimated need checking there
